role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 暗影恶魔可以放出魔性毒云伤害敌人，或侦察战场，胆敢接近他的敌人寥寥无几。将敌人放逐，给友军聚集的时间将其击杀，他还能召唤出敌人的幻象反攻敌人，在他身上施加恶魔的诅咒。
hero_summary_en: Spewing clouds of demonic poison to damage enemies or scout the battlefield, few dare to approach Shadow Demon. Banishing an enemy as his allies gather for the kill, he can inflict demonic curses as he summons traitorous illusions to turn enemy strength against itself.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_disruption
abilities.description_zh: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。
abilities.description_en: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_disseminate
abilities.description_zh: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近%radius%范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
abilities.description_en: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
facet_text_en: If the target is an enemy, they lose %health_lost%%% of their health, regaining half of it after the effect is lifted. If the target is an ally, increases their health by that amount instead.
facet_text_zh: 如果目标是敌人，他们会损失%health_lost%%%生命值，效果结束后会回复一半的生命。如果目标是友军，会增加相应数值的生命。

abilities.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
abilities.description_zh: 在一条直线上造成伤害，并以毒咒折磨敌方单位。根据目标身上的叠加层数，毒咒造成1/2/4/8/16倍的叠加伤害，至多%max_multiply_stacks%层。更多层的叠加每层造成%bonus_stack_damage%点伤害。这部分延缓的伤害在暗影毒的持续时间结束后生效，或者使用附属技能立刻造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes_zh: 暗影剧毒可以作用处于崩裂禁锢的单位。
notes_en: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
abilities.description_zh: 净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。
notes_en: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
abilities.description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。
notes_en: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

abilities.name: shadow_demon_menace
abilities.description_zh: 暗影恶魔的攻击会对敌人施加一个可叠加的负面状态，使他们受到的伤害增加，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。
notes_en: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_shadow_demon_purge_poison
talents_raw.desc_loc: 1 Shadow Poison Stack is applied per second
